description.value: Municipal campground tucked on a forested peninsula in Daajing Giids (Haida Gwaii) with ocean views of surrounding islands and Sleeping Beauty mountain; only 2 walk-in tent sites, outhouse only, and potable water available in summer season only.

address.value: 903A Oceanview Drive, Daajing Giids, BC V0T 1S0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is the campground page at daajinggiids.ca/play/campground/, which explicitly lists amenities: potable water (seasonal), outhouse, bear-proof garbage bins, and a 'RESERVE NOW!' call-to-action confirming reservations are accepted. The website lists 8 RV accessible sites, contradicting the OSM tag capacity:caravans=6; the website is preferred per rules. Phone and address are sourced from the website since OSM records both as empty strings.
concerns: OSM tag capacity:caravans=6 conflicts with website listing 8 RV accessible sites; website value preferred.
Website heading uses 'Haydn Turner Municipal Campground' while OSM records name as 'Haydn Turner Campground'; both forms appear on the website.
Potable water is seasonal (summer season only) and may not be available year-round.
OSM has no address or phone recorded; both contact fields sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active municipal campground on Haida Gwaii with walk-in tent sites, online reservations, and a functional website; a practical and scenic stop for touring cyclists exploring the archipelago.

wow_evidence: forested peninsula in Daajing Giids (Haida Gwaii) with ocean views ... only 2 walk-in tent sites
